items.overview: Chu Feng, a rising star in Qingzhou, accompanied Qinglong Sect Master Li Changqing to the Hundred Sects Conference, Qingzhou's premier event, where he forged a feud with the powerful and domineering Lingyun Sect Master Yan Yangtian. Little did he know, the Hundred Sects Conference, ostensibly a sect competition, was actually a shocking conspiracy by Yan Yangtian. As his strength grew, Chu Feng mastered the power of golden and blue divine thunder. However, this power accidentally disturbed the long-dormant Ice and Fire Pearls, forcing his friends Su Rou and Su Mei to be possessed by the pearls while trying to save Chu Feng, putting their lives in imminent danger. Determined to save his friends, Chu Feng embarked on a treasure hunt in Ten Thousand Demons Mountain, vowing to rescue the Purple-Robed World Spiritist, the Demon Monkey King, and save the two Su brothers. Along the way, Chu Feng met Jiang Wushang, a young man from the imperial dynasty, and reunited with Zi Ling, a girl gifted with a divine body and a mysterious past. He finally reunited with his renowned senior from the same sect, Zhang Tianyi, founder of the Winged Alliance. Ultimately, thanks to the loyalty of Dandan, Ziling, Jiang Wushang, Zhang Tianyi, and others, and his own growing strength, Chu Feng retrieves the Shura Ghost Axe, rescues the Demon Monkey King, successfully rescues the two Su brothers, and uncovers the conspiracy of Lingyun Sect Master Yan Yangtian. Ultimately, he turns the tide and resolves the crisis in Kyushu. To unravel the mystery of his own identity, he embarks on a journey to the vast Eastern Sea... (Source: Tencent, translated)

items.overview: This omnibus adolescent drama is about a group of young girls who all attend a "girls-only musical school," recounting the formative years they shared, at times shifting between different characters' viewpoints and time. Awajima Musical School Training Camp, dubbed the "boarding house," is where young girls gather from all over Japan to perform on stage. Tabata Wakana aspires to be a musical star; housemaster Takehara Kinue attends to carry on her best friend's wishes; beautiful Okabe Emi is a scholarship student who is always at the center of attention; and Ibuki Katsurako, who became a teacher at the school though originally from a family of actresses. items.overview: В живописном тосканском городке Бельведер, обладающем непередаваемым очарованием, живет Элиза - молодая женщина, не склонная к романтическим увлечениям. Её размеренная жизнь, наполненная повседневными заботами и привычной рутиной, кардинально меняется, когда в город возвращается её друг детства. Это событие не только будит воспоминания о прошлых чувствах, но и приносит с собой неожиданные испытания. Элизе предстоит столкнуться с болезненными моментами и непредсказуемыми эмоциями, которые она пыталась оставить позади. Теперь ей необходимо разобраться в своих чувствах и принять непростые решения, которые способны изменить её будущее. items.overview: Although college student Natsuki Haibara has already secured a stable future for himself, he frequently thinks back to his high school days. At the time, he was socially anxious and overweight, and his attempts at becoming outgoing fell completely flat. One evening, Natsuki prays to be able to redo his teenage years and finds out the next morning that he has traveled back in time before his high school debut! Having one month before the entrance ceremony, Natsuki immediately uses this chance to get himself into shape. When the first day of high school finally arrives, he makes a good first impression and befriends familiar faces, including Hikari Hoshimiya, his high school crush. Natsuki quickly realizes that his feelings for Hoshimiya have not changed and makes going out with her his new goal. While enjoying time with Hoshimiya and his other friends, Natsuki rekindles his love for basketball and even secures a part-time job at a local cafe. But with new friends come unfamiliar challenges, and Natsuki must overcome them if he wants to enjoy his adolescence to the fullest. [Written by MAL Rewrite]
